name: App Icon Set Generator (iOS and Android)

seo.title: App Icon Set Generator (iOS and Android) — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Create browser-local iOS and Android raster icon sets plus integration manifests from a single high-resolution master.

assumptions: The source should be square and at least 1024×1024 for high-density targets.
limitations: Platform tooling evolves; generated legacy density sets complement, not replace, Xcode/Android Studio asset validation.
